title: GPT-4V(ision) System Card
before: GPT-4 had image capability described in its report but not released.
problem: Vision raises distinct safety questions, from face recognition to CAPTCHA solving.
breakthrough: A public vision-capable assistant, shipped with a system card documenting the refusals and mitigations.
why: It made multimodal input an everyday feature and set expectations for how visual capability gets released.
next: GPT-4o folded vision, audio and text into one model.
inherits: Images as ordinary input to an assistant.
